name: Karachi Dastarkhwan
tagline: The taste of Karachi, served on one dastarkhwan.

menu.name: Chicken Dum Biryani
menu.description: Aged basmati layered with spiced chicken, potato and saffron, sealed and cooked on dum.

menu.name: Beef Nihari
menu.description: Shank simmered overnight, topped with ginger, green chilli and fresh lemon. Served with naan.

menu.name: Chicken Karahi (Half)
menu.description: Cooked to order in a wok with tomatoes, green chillies and black pepper.

menu.name: Seekh Kabab (4 pcs)
menu.description: Hand-minced beef with herbs, grilled on skewers over live charcoal.

menu.name: Haleem
menu.description: Wheat, lentils and beef slow-pounded into a rich stew, finished with fried onions.

menu.name: Bun Kabab
menu.description: Karachi's street classic: lentil-beef patty, egg, chutney and onions in a toasted bun.

menu.name: Garlic Naan
menu.description: Fresh from the tandoor, brushed with garlic butter and coriander.

menu.name: Shahi Kheer
menu.description: Rice slow-cooked in milk with cardamom, topped with pistachio and almond.

policies.reservations: Taken by phone or through Dastarkhwan Assistant. Every request is confirmed by staff before it is final.
policies.orders: Takeaway orders are requests until staff confirm them by phone.
policies.allergies: Guests should tell staff about any allergies. Dishes may contain nuts, dairy, gluten and egg.
